integrity: Proof is self-contained; finite brick checks and small-board searches are reproducible corroboration, not a substitute for the arbitrary-dimension tiling argument. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: For all m,n>=3 only; no census of all optimizers, no statement about transversal numbers or tensor factors below three. Literature comparison cannot exclude uncatalogued equivalent induced-P3 tiling statements.
title: Optimal geodesic packings in tensor products of complete graphs
